By relying on paragraph No.4 of the counter affidavit of the Special Tas  he submits that pattas were issued to 26 persons belonging to the Arundh  community.
He also points out that there is no provision for reconveyanc  Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Harijan Welfare Schemes Act, (Act 31   1978).
